root_draft.speaker: agent
root_draft.text: Greentide is a steaming river jungle whose abundance makes entering it worthwhile and whose living pressure makes holding a home there a daily struggle. Food, timber, strange catches and useful medicines come from the same place that hides predators, swarms with stinging insects, exhausts its workers with fever and swallows people and supplies in churnmud. A colony earns working space: it clears routes, protects its doorways with dry-air blowers, makes firm ground, pulls people free and digs its belongings back out. A greatbole offers another bargain: carve shelter and valuable heartwood from a living trunk, seal the chambers you mean to keep, and face increasingly violent consequences if you take too much. Learned tools and fever survivors make the colony more capable; the jungle's danger does not rise to cancel that learning. Success is an abundant, hard-won foothold that still needs care, with understandable warnings and a chance to act when its defenses fail.

failure_modes: F1: The living jungle is scenery: food and hazards exist, but daily growth never contests the colony, maintaining space has no payoff, or a visit shows mud alone. Sources: design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; src/RimMandrake/ExplosiveGrowth/Source/RM_TopResolver.cs.

F2: Abundance has no believable bargain: rewards do not justify the expedition, preparation gains nothing, Frenzy becomes routine free work, or Greatbole greed and patience do not produce different consequences. Sources: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/greentide_risk_reward_2026-09-22.md; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/kits/greatbole_harvest_spec.md.

F3: The jungle wins through broken or unreadable rules: rescues strand pawns, buried goods change identity, defenses fail without actionable signs, healing behaves unlike its warning, or normal work at forty colonists becomes repeated manual rescue. Sources: src/RimMandrake/Greentide/Source/RM_MapComponent_MudSwallow.cs; src/RimMandrake/Greentide/Source/RM_JobDriver_FreeMired.cs; src/RimMandrake/EnvironmentalHazards/Source/RM_MapComponent_LivingRegrowth.cs.

neighbours.text: Living-bole/road map placement, regrowth, fall/gnaw/shatter, dry field, cooler, steam vortices, weather conditions and found-tech study. Greentide owns content/ladder/fruitfall. Use shared services, no duplicate engines.
Lunger, seek-shade, silence, sight grid, reaction budget/spawn/aggression, seed passage, fruit-defense and breeding. Greentide supplies opt-in defs.
Rates, wet-native cycles/tree life, light gating and common suppression. Blower/grazing directly call this API; prove actual protected space, not just registered cells.
One geometric Direct Sun model, canopy/roofs and vanilla temperature/Heatstroke. No second wet-bulb hediff or biome-specific sun invented.
Shared giant-body/trunk interaction, click behavior and titan consequences; no custom Greentide footprint engine proposed. Actual content opt-ins must be read/tested, not inferred from size alone.
Optional guarded biome payload; scanner owns pulse and banded readings.

Gauranlen connections/dryads, mining/wardening/work priorities, research/study, medical bill, fishing and vanilla heat are reused. TropicalSwamp is the one built-in density/path-cost comparison already measured in density items; no external recommendations needed.
Adds genuine canon roster/catch and Wildsteam binding. Free content is not replaced. Rites v2; fixed planet paint later, zero tiles not a defect.
